2: A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance. Jehovah, rebuke me not in thy wrath; neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
3: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand cometh down upon me.
4: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine indignation; no peace in my bones, because of my sin.
5: For mine iniquities are gone over my head: as a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
6: My wounds stink, they are corrupt, because of my foolishness.
7: I am depressed; I am bowed down beyond measure; I go mourning all the day.
8: For my loins are full of burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.
9: I am faint and broken beyond measure; I roar by reason of the agitation of my heart.
10: Lord, all my desire is before thee, and my sighing is not hid from thee.
11: My heart throbbeth, my strength hath left me; and the light of mine eyes, it also is no more with me.
12: My lovers and mine associates stand aloof from my stroke; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
13: And they that seek after my life lay snares [for me]; and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all the day long.
14: But I, as a deaf [man], hear not; and am as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
15: Yea, I am as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
16: For in thee, Jehovah, do I hope: thou wilt answer, O Lord myGod.
17: For I said, Let them not rejoice over me! When my foot slipped, they magnified [themselves] against me.
18: For I am ready to halt, and my pain is continually before me.
19: For I will declare mine iniquity, I am grieved for my sin.
20: But mine enemies are lively, they are strong; and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied:
21: And they that render evil for good are adversaries unto me; because I pursue what is good.
22: Forsake me not, Jehovah; O myGod, be not far from me.
23: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation.
